idea-plugin.name: Claude & Codex Usage (local build)
idea-plugin.description:
Displays your Claude and Codex subscription usage limits in separate IDE status-bar widgets.

Note: This plugin tracks subscription quota usage only (5-hour, 7-day limits). It does not track API tokens, costs, or conversation history.

Features:
  • Separate Claude and Codex progress widgets with independent detail popups
  • Bundled provider favicons keep both status indicators compact and recognizable
  • Real-time usage percentage with auto-refresh every minute (configurable)
  • Reads credentials from the macOS Keychain (where Claude Code stores them) with fallback to the credentials file
  • Manual refresh button for instant updates
  • Color-coded progress indicator (green → yellow → red)
  • Once the displayed window hits 100%, the indicator switches to the credit spend now accruing ($20.74 of $1,000.00) on its own amber → red scale, and switches back when usage drops below the limit
  • Optional chime on each switch — a low note when credit spend starts, a brighter one when the window resets — so you know without watching the status bar
  • Time until quota reset
  • Detailed popup with all usage tiers (5-hour, weekly all-models, weekly model-scoped, usage credits)
  • Configurable settings (Settings → Tools → Claude & Codex Usage)
  • Works behind corporate proxies: auto-detects HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY from ~/.claude/settings.json or the environment, with an option to override
  • Dark and light theme support
  • Error state display with actionable hints

Requirements: Enable the provider widgets you use. Claude requires an authenticated Claude Code CLI; Codex requires an installed and authenticated Codex CLI.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.2-local.5
  • Added a separate Codex status-bar progress widget and independent Codex usage popup
  • Codex usage comes from the installed CLI's local app-server protocol; the plugin does not read or store Codex tokens
  • Added bundled Claude and Codex favicons to the two compact status indicators
  • Added independent Claude/Codex widget toggles and an optional Codex executable path
0.3.2
  • Proxy support for the usage API request: auto-detects HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY from ~/.claude/settings.json (falling back to the environment variables), with a new "Proxy URL" setting to override it manually (supports http://user:pass@host:port)
  • SOCKS proxy URLs (socks://, socks4://, socks5://) are recognised as SOCKS proxies instead of being treated as HTTP proxies
  • New proxy error state: HTTP 407, a failed CONNECT tunnel or an unreachable proxy is now reported as a proxy problem with an actionable hint, instead of a generic "offline"
  • Proxy URL "none" forces a direct connection even when HTTPS_PROXY is set, and a malformed Proxy URL is now rejected when applying settings instead of silently connecting directly
0.3.1
  • Live usage popup: the refresh button now shows a countdown until it is available again, and usage values update in place without closing/reopening the popup
  • Optional IDE notification when the status bar quota crosses the yellow or red threshold (configurable in settings, on by default)
  • Settings button added to the usage popup, next to Refresh, for quick access to plugin settings
  • Fixed black/empty usage popup on the macOS Metal rendering pipeline (reported on WebStorm 2026.1 / macOS 26): the popup content now paints an explicit opaque background and forces a repaint once shown
0.3.0
  • macOS Keychain support: reads OAuth tokens from the Keychain (where Claude Code now stores them), with fallback to the credentials file
  • New "Use macOS Keychain" setting (default on, macOS only)
  • Dedicated error states and actionable popup hints for keychain access denied / prompt timeout
  • On first run, macOS will prompt once for keychain access — click Always Allow for your IDE
0.2.4
  • Fixed parse error when API returns null reset time for unused quotas (widget no longer falls into error state)
  • Configurable auto-refresh interval (1–60 minutes, default 1 minute)
  • Manual refresh button now has its own 5-second cooldown, independent of the auto-refresh interval
  • Reset time hidden in UI when API reports no reset
  • Max backoff on errors increased to 60 minutes
0.2.3
  • Refresh button disabled when last fetch was less than 1 minute ago
  • Exponential backoff on all API errors to reduce unnecessary calls
0.2.2
  • Countdown timer now shows days when reset time exceeds 24 hours (e.g. "2d 14h 1m")
0.2.1
  • Updated User-Agent header to fix usage API that stopped working
  • Exponential backoff retry on rate limiting
0.2.0
  • Settings panel (Settings → Tools → Claude Code Usage): configurable quota display, warning thresholds, credentials path
  • Refresh button in usage popup
  • Error state display with actionable hints
  • Dark and light theme support
  • Fixed widget visibility issues
  • Platform version bumped to 2024.1+
